content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge resolves the D4/C2 collision over Luke 2:48-49 by immediate phrase qualification instead of weighing the named chains by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse': one reading forbids resolving the collision by immediate phrase qualification; the other permits immediate context within a verse-pair to answer it.","why":"The judge's stated reason is that Luke 2:48's phrase is qualified by Luke 2:49's phrase, a verse-by-verse resolution rather than the required chain-against-chain footing."}
